attribution.text: GBIF.org, with the DOI of each dataset or download used

rights.licence: Per dataset: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0 or CC-BY-NC-4.0

provenance.notes: API reference (techdocs.gbif.org/en/openapi) read live 2026-11-10: no fixed rate; "Rapid or numerous queries to search APIs may be rate limited, depending on our server load" with HTTP 429 (reduce the rate or use the download API); "we do not guarantee any particular query rate will work". GBIF "highly recommend[s]" a User-Agent holding a URL or e-mail address so it can contact the integrator (recommended, not required; this package puts its mailto there). No rate-limit headers on a test call. www.gbif.org answered 403 to automated reads; the Data User Agreement and the licensing terms were read in Wayback snapshots (2026-07-24, 2026-08-31): each occurrence dataset carries one of CC0 1.0, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0, chosen by its publisher, and the publisher's licence prevails; commercial use is therefore per record (forbidden for CC BY-NC records) and unknown at source level; users must publicly acknowledge the data publishers, where appropriate by the DOI of the datasets/downloads, and keep the ownership identifier with every record shared onward; APIs must not be used to disrupt the service. The per-record licence is in each answer (license).
